title: Scope note - Ch. III Art. V items 1-9 and 11.d-11.g not seeded
notes: Not a fee rule. Items 1-9 of the Ch. III Art. V schedule (building, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, electronics permit and related construction fees) are documented in docs/revenue-code-extract.md but intentionally not seeded: BizTrack issues certificates of occupancy, not construction permits. Item 11 sub-schedules 11.d-11.g (annual plumbing/electrical/mechanical/electronics inspections) cross-reference those trade permit schedules and are likewise not seeded; only the occupancy-linked tables 11.a-11.c are. The item 4.b transformer/UPS/generator fee table is missing from the scan entirely (Appendix A item 1) - out of this file's scope.

title: Certificate of Use or Occupancy - Division J-2 accessory structures (garages, carports, balconies, terraces, lanais and the like)
notes: Ordinance text: '50% of the rate of the principal building of which they are accessories'. The principal building's own rate depends on its division and cost/area, which is not a fact of the J-2 application, so this rule encodes 50% of the J-1 (10.d) floor-area schedule as the computable proxy; an officer may adjust via adjustFee when the principal building's actual rate differs.
defects: Derived: 50% of J-1 per 10.e as printed - the ordinance prints only the 50% rule, not amounts; bracket values are halved from 10.d.
Row 5,000-10,000 sq. m derives 100.00 from the printed (possibly misprinted) 200.00 in 10.d.v; DO 155 reference would give 300.00 (Appendix A item 4).

defects: Inherits 10.d defects: 10.d.v prints 200.00 vs DO 155 reference 600.00 (Appendix A item 4); trailing-zero margin truncations per Appendix A item 15.

title: Certificate of Use or Occupancy - Division J-2 towers (radio/TV transmission, cell site, sign, water tank supports), first 10.00 meters of height
notes: Covers the first 10.00 meters of height from the ground, any location; pairs with occupancy.cert_j2_tower_excess for height above 10 m.

title: Certificate of Use or Occupancy - Division J-2 towers, every meter or fraction thereof in excess of 10.00 meters
notes: tower_height_excess_m = whole meters of height above 10.00 m, fractions rounded up ('every meter or fraction thereof'). Zero when the tower is 10 m or less.

title: Change in Use/Occupancy, per sq. meter or fraction thereof of area affected
notes: floor_area_sqm here is the area affected by the change of use; fractions of a sq. meter round up ('or fraction thereof').

title: Annual inspection - Divisions A-1 and A-2, owner-requested services
notes: Single detached dwelling units and duplexes are NOT subject to annual inspections; billed only if the owner requests, at P120.00 for each requested service among: land use conformity, architectural presentability, structural stability, sanitary and health requirements, fire-resistive requirements. Bills on renewal (annual), encoded as is_new_business false.

title: Certified true copy of Certificate of Use/Occupancy
Other OBO certifications (item 12, rows a and c-h)
notes: All eight item-12 rows carry the same P50.00 fee, so they are not seeded individually. Covered here: certified true copy of building permit (a); issuance and certified true copy of Certificate of Damage (c, d); certified true copy of Electrical Certificate (e); issuance of Certificate of Gas Meter Installation (f) - gas meter certificate must specify manufacturer, serial number, gas type, meter classification/model, maximum allowable operating pressure, hub size, capacity; certified true copy of Certificate of Operation (g); other certifications (h). The certified true copy of Certificate of Use/Occupancy (b) has its own rule, occupancy.cert_true_copy.
